detail.longDescription: I've been building Phials for the better part of 5 years, and am excited to finally be releasing it in beta. I'm a productivity app nerd, and Phials combines a proper file manager with my favorite paradigms from knowledge work and productivity tools from over the past decade. The tech stack has changed over the years, but it's been on Rust/GPUI/Wry/Svelte for quite some time now. Alongside it is a very opinionated Svelte UI library called Phoundry UI that was built specifically for Phials, including a 700+ hand crafted icon library. Thanks for checking it out <3
